description: Http(S) Traffic Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Pradeep Bangera (IMDEA Networks Institute). This dataset contains HTTP/HTTPS raw traffic data collected by crawling top 2,165 websites using VPN vantage points from 52 countries. The objective of crawling each website from different countries is to discover various geographic-specific hostnames used by the websites to serve content across geography. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
